title: Smarter Sanity Studio v4
description: Complete refactoring of Sanity Studio with data safety, migration automation, and removal of unused features.
goals: Export all data before any changes

phases.name: Data Safety
phases.description: Export all data before any schema changes

tasks.name: Export all documents
tasks.description: Export all documents from Sanity CMS

tasks.name: Export all assets
tasks.description: Export all images and files from Sanity

tasks.name: Export schema definitions
tasks.description: Export all schema type definitions

tasks.name: Create restore scripts
tasks.description: Create scripts to restore data from backup

tasks.name: Verify backup
tasks.description: Verify backup integrity and completeness

phases.name: Schema & Content
phases.description: Consolidate schema types and migrate content

tasks.name: Remove heroSection
tasks.description: Remove heroSection schema (already merged into profile)

tasks.name: Remove skillsToolPlugin
tasks.description: Remove unused skills tool from studio

tasks.name: Add customImage type
tasks.description: Create unified image type for all image fields

tasks.name: Remove old reference types
tasks.description: Remove seoImage, ogImage, twitterImage reference types

tasks.name: Migrate content
tasks.description: Run migration scripts to update content

phases.name: Studio Features
phases.description: Enhance studio features for better UX

tasks.name: Enhance Presentation tool
tasks.description: Add visual indicators, keyboard shortcuts, improved navigator

tasks.name: Enhance Desk structure
tasks.description: Add document counters, quick actions, search, favorites

tasks.name: Enhance Content health
tasks.description: Add content scoring, fix suggestions, health history

tasks.name: Enhance Validation
tasks.description: Add cross-field validation, business rules, custom validators

tasks.name: Add Smart templates
tasks.description: Add template selection, auto-fill, gallery, versioning

tasks.name: Enhance Inspector panels
tasks.description: Add tab system, SEO preview, data consistency, performance

tasks.name: Enhance Onboarding
tasks.description: Add content completion, personalized tips, video tutorials, achievements

tasks.name: Enhance Automation
tasks.description: Add content scheduling, publish reminders, bulk actions, workflows

tasks.name: Final verification
tasks.description: Run all tests and type checks

tasks.name: Deploy studio
tasks.description: Deploy to Sanity Hosting

tasks.name: Post-deploy checks
tasks.description: Verify production deployment

risks.name: Data loss during migration
risks.mitigation: Backup before any changes, verify backup, test restore

risks.name: Schema changes break existing content
risks.mitigation: Test schema changes locally, use idempotent migrations

risks.name: Studio build fails after changes
risks.mitigation: Run type checks after each change, fix errors immediately

risks.name: Production deployment fails
risks.mitigation: Test build before deploy, have rollback plan ready
